subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: The WorkTracker port contract and its conformance kit stay medium-agnostic — binding this adapter changes no kernel or judgment code, and any future adapter (GitHub, Linear) passes the identical kit
rationale: AP-1/AP-3/INV-37: the medium is swappable, the port is not specialized
fit_criterion: zero diff to `internal/kernel` or `internal/judgment` to bind the adapter; the kit contains no `localfs`-specific symbol
